text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Right then! What should I do for fun on my 
next day off~? If I'm doing it, might as 
well make it a huge, flashy blast with 
everyone—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Wait a sec. Come to think of it, how much 
cash do I have left?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right... I went and splurged 
the other day too.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Darn it! Guess I'll have to find some free 
ways to entertain myself for a while...
